subject: Getting you set up: pick a hands-on demo time
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@acmeanalytics.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-17T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Signed up — interested in a demo

Hi Lauren,

I just signed up for the self-serve trial (account: Acme Analytics). I'm the engineering lead on our NLP team and would love a short hands-on demo focused on latency and embeddings workflows — ideally sometime this week.

A bit about us: we're evaluating inference providers for a search/semantic retrieval MVP. Main constraints are 100ms p95 on short queries and SSO for the admin console.

Available windows: Thu/Fri afternoons PT. Happy to share more context if helpful.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Engineering Lead, Acme Analytics
samir@acmeanalytics.com

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Samir Patel <samir@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-17T09:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Signed up — interested in a demo

Hi Samir — welcome and thanks for signing up. Great to meet you (virtually).

I've got a short 20-minute technical walkthrough that covers inference performance tuning, embeddings routing, and a quick look at our dedicated vs. hosted tradeoffs. You can pick a slot that works best here: https://cal.redwood.com/lauren-bishop/20min

If you'd like to pull in an engineer from our side to dig into latency numbers live, select the slot labeled "Engineer on call" and I'll loop them in.

Quick next steps:
- Click the link and pick one of the Fri afternoon slots (I reserved a few).
- If none of the times work, reply with 2-3 preferred windows and I or Kar will set it up.

Attachment: trial-intake.pdf (one-page intake form — copy of the trial config you set during signup, please review)

Looking forward to it.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Samir Patel <samir@acmeanalytics.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-17T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Signed up — interested in a demo

Thanks Lauren — I grabbed the 2:30pm PT Fri slot via the link.

One follow-up: will this include a brief review of how to configure prefix/KV caching? That's our main cost-saving knob. Also, we have a compliance review — is there someone who can quickly confirm data residency options during the call?

Samir
